items.name: Social Hub
items.tagline: Keep your friends list and chat notes together.
items.description: Social Hub is an optional built-in Voidcraft feature. It lets you add usernames to a local friends list and save local chat notes on this device. These are not real friend requests or messages: online accounts, cross-device sync, invites, notifications, and live chat require a server integration that is not included yet.

items.name: Advanced Mod Manager
items.tagline: Import, organize, enable, disable, export, and remove JAR mods.
items.description: Optional built-in manager for Minecraft Java mod JAR files. In the combined engine build it reads the active Minecraft mods directory, imports and exports JARs, toggles enabled files to .jar.disabled and back, and removes them from that folder. Changes require restarting the game. Mods must match the selected Minecraft version and installed loader. The standalone prototype uses a private fallback directory.
items.compatibility: Voidcraft combined Android beta; mods must match game version and loader

items.name: Server State
items.tagline: Check live Minecraft server status, player counts, versions, and MOTD.
items.description: Optional built-in Minecraft Java and Bedrock server status checker. Save up to 30 addresses on this device, refresh status on demand, and view online state, player count, version, and MOTD using the public mcsrvstat.us service. Server addresses are stored locally; each check sends the address to that provider. Results may be unavailable or inaccurate for servers that block status queries.
items.compatibility: VoidCraft Android beta; network access required

items.name: Theme Studio
items.tagline: Customize the VoidCraft launcher accent with presets or custom RGB colors.
items.description: Optional built-in theme editor. Choose Neon Mint, Void Violet, Arctic Ice, Solar Ember, or customize RGB channels. Preview the color, apply it to the launcher's primary accent, and save the choice locally on this device. This does not modify Minecraft textures or resource packs.

items.name: Cosmetic Store
items.tagline: Browse original profile effects and equip a local launcher cosmetic.
items.description: Optional built-in cosmetic wardrobe with Void Aura, Neon Mint, Arctic Ice, and Solar Ember. Select and unequip a cosmetic; the choice is saved locally on this device and displayed in the VoidCraft launcher profile preview. This does not alter Minecraft skins, game files, or multiplayer appearance.
items.compatibility: VoidCraft Android beta; launcher profile preview only
